detail: term sheet declares barrier_level_pct absent; booking has 70

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G10 contains no knock-in barrier provision — no clause states a barrier level as a percentage of initial, and the extractors returned no citable span. The booking record nevertheless carries barrier_level_pct = 70. Confirm whether the note is in fact barrier-linked and the term sheet is missing or omits the knock-in language (e.g. a supplement, annex or final terms not supplied), or whether the note is unbarriered and the booking value of 70 must be removed. If a barrier applies, provide the governing document and the exact clause fixing the 70% level and its observation basis (continuous vs. final valuation).
triage.rationale: A booked 70% knock-in barrier is a core economic term unlikely to be invented at booking, so the more probable explanation is an incomplete or superseded term sheet lacking the barrier clause rather than a booking error — though the desk must confirm which.
